property_summary: In the reference contract, pastBlockTime is always strictly greater than the previous call's pastBlockTime after any successful fallback, so two successful calls can never occur in the same block. The buggy version allows two calls in the same block, and when the second call resets pastBlockTime to the same timestamp, pastBlockTime remains unchanged from the first call's update.
change_summary: Change block.timestamp > pastBlockTime to >= so same-block calls can succeed, affecting state updates and possible transfers.
